room_rent.note: If higher room taken, proportionate deduction on associated medical expenses applies

icu.note: ICU/ICCU expenses capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment stated in wording; proportionate deduction applies only if higher room is chosen

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per year; modern treatments capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions except HIV/AIDS

specific_disease_waiting.note: 19 listed conditions including hernia, cataract, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under standard exclusion Excl18

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days after discharge

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered under inpatient care section

domiciliary.note: Home Care Treatment covered up to 10% of SI or ₹1 lakh, whichever is lower; prior approval required; domiciliary hospitalisation as defined is excluded per specific exclusion 11

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of organs by insured is specifically excluded; organ donor harvesting expenses definition exists but donation by insured is excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments covered up to 50% of sum insured

consumables.note: Consumables listed under non-payable items (List I); no rider available

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is specifically excluded

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years no claim can be contested except for proven fraud

grace_period.note: Coverage not available during grace period

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or portability

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI guidelines; waiting period credit transferred

notable_exclusions.display: No overseas treatment, no maternity, no ART for HIV, no domiciliary hosp, STDs (non-HIV), stem cell storage, alternative therapies

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
